chats.answer:
If you're looking for a portable Apple CarPlay screen for a motorcycle, I'd recommend a 5–7-inch waterproof display that mounts to your handlebars and connects wirelessly to your iPhone.

Unlike a car CarPlay screen, a motorcycle version should be designed for rain, vibration, sunlight, and glove operation.

What to look for

Wireless Apple CarPlay — connects to your iPhone without a cable.

IP67 waterproofing — important for riding in rain.

High-brightness display — readable in direct sunlight.

Handlebar mounting — preferably with vibration-resistant hardware.

Helmet Bluetooth compatibility — for navigation instructions, calls, and music.

Quick removal — useful if you park your motorcycle outdoors.
